title: Astro Portal session event payload: note
description: A free-text field note, the catch-all entry for anything the other seven typed events do not cover — and the correction event of the registry: a note carrying `pauseCause` gives a cause to a `pause` already recorded (the journal is append-only, so a cause chosen after the tap is a new event naming the pause, never an edit of it). Such a correction needs no text. A note carrying `appStopped` records, at the application's next cold start, the stretch during which it did not run in the middle of an open session (from its last sign of life to that start); it needs no text either. See session-events.md for what this type is for and what it deliberately is not.

targetId.description: Optional: attaches the note to a target already named by a target_started event in this session (catalogue id, or the same free label used there).

pauseCause.description: Gives `cause` to the pause event `pauseEventId` of the same session. When several corrections name the same pause, the latest by recordedAt (then eventId) wins, and a correction always wins over the pause's own `cause`.

appStopped.description: The application did not run from `from` (its last sign of life) to `to` (its next cold start) while this session was open. The capture is assumed to have gone on: the time stays counted, as automatic time not confirmed yet, until a later auto_time_confirmed of the target (session-passages). `to` is after `from`; a reader ignores a note whose `to` is not after its `from`.
